headline: California offers $3,500 EV rebate for first-time buyers
summary: California's MyFirstEV program provides up to $3,500 rebate for first-time EV buyers. The program is part of a $600 million investment in clean transportation.
details: California's MyFirstEV program offers up to $3,500 instant rebate for first-time EV buyers. The rebate is available for new EVs with MSRP under $50,000 and used EVs under $25,000.

The program is part of a larger $600 million investment by California to improve the state's clean transportation economy. Half of the program's $270 million fund comes from California's 2026-2027 state budget, while the other half is sourced from participating automakers.
Eligible vehicles are all zero emission, which means full battery electric cars, no hybrids. The rebate is available as an instant discount through dealerships.
caption:
California offers $3,500 EV rebate for first-time buyers. Will this boost EV sales?

California's MyFirstEV program offers up to $3,500 instant rebate for first-time EV buyers. The rebate is available for new EVs with MSRP under $50,000 and used EVs under $25,000.

The program is part of a larger $600 million investment by California to improve the state's clean transportation economy. Half of the program's $270 million fund comes from California's 2026-2027 state budget, while the other half is sourced from participating automakers.

Eligible vehicles are all zero emission, which means full battery electric cars, no hybrids. The rebate is available as an instant discount through dealerships.
